_comment: Declarative policy-as-code rules. Allowed conditions: passport -> category_in, approval, field_is_unknown; change -> access_mode_transition, approval; event -> action_mutating, approval; activity -> check (a named, built-in timeline detector), max_skew_seconds. All conditions in a rule must hold. Nothing here is executed as code.

rules.title: Unapproved database MCP server
rules.explanation: The server's config shows explicit database evidence (package, image or command) and approvals.json has no approved record for this passport.

rules.title: Access mode downgraded to UNKNOWN after a config edit
rules.explanation: The confirmed passport had proven read-only access, but the edited config no longer carries that evidence. Access is now UNKNOWN until a human re-reviews it.

rules.title: Owner not attested
rules.explanation: No owner is declared in the config. AutoDiscover will not guess one, so accountability is missing.

rules.title: Version not attested
rules.explanation: No version is declared in the config, so the exact build in use cannot be pinned or audited.

rules.title: Mutating action without approval
rules.explanation: A consented runtime event shows a write/delete-type action that no approval record covers.

rules.title: Activity log rewritten since its checkpoint
rules.explanation: The observer log no longer starts with the bytes saved in its LENGTH:SHA256 checkpoint. Earlier records were changed or removed.

rules.title: Read-only run changed a file
rules.explanation: The observer started this run with read-only access, yet it recorded a file change under that run.

rules.title: Protected file changed
rules.explanation: The observer marked the file as protected. Check whether the change was expected.

rules.title: File change without approval
rules.explanation: The observer recorded approval as missing or denied for this file change.

rules.title: File change with no identified actor
rules.explanation: No observed run started the change. The actor stays UNKNOWN until stronger evidence appears.

rules.title: Agent gained write access
rules.explanation: The same observer identity (deployment, agent, instance) ran read-only before and with write access now.

rules.title: Tool configuration file changed
rules.explanation: An MCP or client config file was changed, which can add tools or widen what an agent can reach. Re-scan in 01 Discover.

rules.title: Gap or repeat in the observer log
rules.explanation: The observer's sequence numbers skip or repeat. Check collector coverage before relying on this timeline.

rules.title: Event and observer clocks disagree
rules.explanation: The event time differs from the observer time by more than the allowed skew. Check time sync or delayed delivery.

rules.title: Agent's own report disagrees with the observer
rules.explanation: A record the agent reported about itself is missing from, or different in, the independent observer log.

rules.title: Agent renamed or moved under the same identity
rules.explanation: The observer supplied the same identity with a different name or location. Same agent, new label.

rules.title: Activity without confirmed onboarding
rules.explanation: The observer reported that this agent's onboarding was not confirmed.

rules.title: Run reference reused
rules.explanation: Two runs started with the same run reference, so which execution did what is UNKNOWN.

rules.title: Possible indirect prompt injection
rules.explanation: An untrusted attachment was present and the observer recorded a file change outside the approved task scope. Review the attachment and the action before attributing a cause.
